speaker: A
hook_line: We closed 12 deals last quarter entirely through outbound.
transcript: We closed 12 deals last quarter entirely through outbound. No paid ads, no inbound leads — just signals and sequences. The secret was custom intent signals. Instead of watching generic job-change alerts, we built our own signal around one specific trigger: companies that added a VP of Sales in the last 30 days. That one signal converted at 4× our baseline. The reason is timing. A new VP of Sales has 90 days to prove they can build pipeline. They are actively looking for tools, and they have budget authority right away. We layered on a second signal: companies that posted an open SDR role in the same 30-day window. That doubled the confidence score. If a company is hiring sellers and just brought in a new VP, they are building a team and they need a platform. The result was 23 meetings in one month from a list of under 400 accounts. That is a 5.75 percent meeting rate on cold outbound, which is about 10× the industry average.
